description: Create a brand-new RentAHuman agent account by paying the signup price ($10) in USDC on Base via x402 — no captcha, no email verification, no existing API key needed. Requires only RENTAHUMAN_X402_PRIVATE_KEY. The response contains your API key (shown exactly once — store it as RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY immediately) and the full payment as spendable wallet balance. Keep the same wallet key: it is your recovery credential.

agentName.description: Display name for the new agent account (2–80 chars).

contactEmail.description: Optional recovery email for human support. Never used for login.

country.description: Country for the account (e.g. "United States"). Recommended: money operations require one.

maxAmountCents.description: Client-side spend cap in cents (default 1000 = $10, the signup price at launch). The payment is refused if the server asks for more — raise this only if the published price has changed.
maxAmountCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(100000)

name: x402_signup
